messages:
Jordan Lee: hey team, Jordan again. couple follow-ups from my onboarding checklist: who owns approvals for dedicated GPU capacity requests, who signs off on KMS/HSM key access for private deployments, and what's the canonical oncall/escalation contact if a rollout causes throttling? also, is VPN access still handled by People Ops or security infra?

Priya Gupta: hi Jordan! short answers: VPN + Okta groups -> People Ops (me). KMS/HSM key material provisioning needs Security approval + ticket to #eng-security. For dedicated GPU approvals there's a cost review + infra lead signoff (see below).

Maya Patel: adding detail on the dedicated GPU flow:
```
1) submit infra request form (/forms/dedicated-gpu)
2) include cost owner + expected QPS
3) Eng-Platform reviews perf/placement
4) Finance approves budget if monthly > $Xk
5) provisioning scheduled by Eng-Infra
```
If you're just testing small capacity you can request a short-lived sandbox (no finance approval).

Samir Ortiz: escalation/contact for rollouts that cause throttling: Eng-Platform pager first for perf regressions; Eng-SRE oncall for system outages. Basic matrix: 
```
- perf/regression (degraded latency): page eng-platform-oncall -> 10m -> escalate to Eng-Platform lead
- outage (SLO breach): page eng-sre-oncall -> 5m -> escalate to Samir Ortiz
- security/data exposure: page sec-oncall immediately
```

Devon Ramos: for model rollout gating (quality/regression) we require a quick eval snapshot + owners listed. If you plan to flip traffic to a new model >10% you need an A/B plan and an owner who can rollback. We usually cc eng-platform and eng-ml leads in that PR.

Priya Gupta: VPN note: you may need device enrollment for corp devices. Ping me with your laptop serial and I'll start the Okta group invite. For KMS/HSM exceptions, security will ask for a risk memo (1 paragraph) + approver (team manager).

ops-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist item 'security training' is due in 7 days. https://intranet.redwood/onboarding/checklist

Jordan Lee: great — this helps a lot. i'll file the /forms/dedicated-gpu for a small sandbox and include finance if we scale. i'll also open the KMS ticket if we need key access for private infra. can someone drop the handbook link for the ownership roster?

Maya Patel: handbook roster (outdated but useful): https://intranet.redwood/handbook/ownership-roster. i'll open a PR to refresh it with the flows above and tag you to review, Jordan.

Jordan Lee: thanks Maya, Priya, Samir, Devon. feel free to DM me if you want me to take notes and submit the PR to the handbook. :thumbsup:
